The TalkBank Ground Rules license the data under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, which "precludes the incorporation of the data in commercial products, including systems such as large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT". On web processing, data "can only be uploaded for processing by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Rev-AI and similar systems if the user has specifically selected the option for non-storage of data": "Help improve Claude" off for Anthropic, "improve the model for everyone" off for OpenAI, Gemini Apps Activity off for Google. Local analysis has no such limit. Identifiable data may "only be stored on a local device for analysis and cannot be circulated further". In November 2026 the CHILDES home page said the repository was "under review for potential modification in compliance with Administration directives", so record the date and version of any download.
